overview.title: Spindle
overview.description: The performance of CNC machines in manufacturing wood and metal products relies on the efficiency of mechanisms involved in material processing. In a milling machine, the spindle—receiving instructions from the CNC—fulfills this role.

power.title: Power
power.description: Often, the spindle needs to be selected based on the specific tasks the machine performs, so the required power parameter can indicate the type of device to purchase. Different types of machining tasks require varying equipment power.
power.work_type_2: Wood cutting (including the entire range of milling operations)

slider.description: Spindle specs affect machine work and part quality. Prior to selecting one for a CNC machine, understanding its features and productivity coefficient is key.

quantity.title: Spindle quantity
quantity.description: The number of spindles on a milling machine's gantry determines its ability to simultaneously process multiple parts or perform various operations without the need for reconfiguration. This significantly enhances production efficiency.
quantity.pcs1_val1: For small volumes and sequential operations
quantity.pcs1_val2: More flexibility in setup but less parallel processing
quantity.pcs2_val1: Simultaneous work with multiple parts and operations

plate_type.title: Plate type
plate_type.description: These are surfaces or platforms where machine components or tools are positioned and secured for operation on the machine.
plate_type.plate_type_1_val: In this case, the spindle is located on a single plate, providing a unified and integrated structure.
plate_type.plate_type_2_val: Here, spindles are placed on separate plates, but their operation relies on each other. They are coordinated and interdependent during processing
plate_type.plate_type_3_val: These plates have individual spindles, each functioning independently. This allows for more flexible and autonomous operations on the machine.

structure.title: Spindle structure
structure.sentense_1: The foundation consists of a rotary shaft supported by bearings within the housing.
structure.sentense_2: An electric motor embedded within the device ensures rotation.
structure.sentense_3: Cutting tools are secured on the shaft using collets to accommodate tools with various shanks.
structure.sentense_4: Installing the spindle at the machine's headstock is achieved through a special carriage, enabling movement along the X, Y, and Z axes.

cooling.title: Spindle cooling
cooling.overview: Cooling of the spindle machine is essential for its prolonged operation. An integrated cooling system ensures high performance and safe usage. Typically, air or liquid cooling methods are employed.

air.title: Air cooling
air.description: Through dedicated air intakes, it stimulates airflow within the device casing. Despite the noise, it remains a cost-effective option.

water.title: Water cooling
water.description: Water cooling offers quieter operation and enhanced efficiency, amplifying the spindle's power. For instance, a 3.5 kW spindle utilizing water cooling can engrave steel, a task beyond the capabilities of an equally powered spindle relying on air cooling.

video.title: Watch our video on how the spindle is constructed
video.info: Depending on the tool used (end mills, engravers, drills), a corresponding collet (ER11, ER16) is utilized, as indicated in the spindle manual.

spindle_info.info_block: Company WATTSAN has tested dozens of Chinese spindles and identified ones with exceptional reliability and technical characteristics, ensuring unparalleled spindle quality and performance in machines.
